abstract: Maintains egress plans, floor layout safety configurations, and hall seating capacities
system_message:
You are the Event operations director (OPS), responsible for maintaining egress plans, floor layout safety configurations, and hall seating capacities across candidate convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Banqueting readiness（CATER）
information_points.content:
OPS-CATER-O7J：At the Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre, the catering service assessment indicates an hourly banquet throughput of 450 meals/h from the primary banquet kitchen facilities during peak gala dinner service.
OPS-CATER-7C4：At the Olympus Grand Forum Complex, the peak gala dinner catering assessment records an hourly banquet throughput of 600 meals/h for the primary banquet kitchen facilities.
OPS-CATER-4VA：At the Starlight Exhibition and Congress Park, evaluation of primary banquet kitchen facilities during peak gala dinner service shows an hourly banquet throughput of 800 meals/h.

information_points.title: Maintains egress plans, floor layout safety configurations, and hall seating capacities（PLEN）
information_points.content:
OPS-PLEN-XO5：For the Starlight Exhibition and Congress Park, the emergency egress plan is active across interior corridors and emergency exits according to the safety verification log, and its plenary seating capacity in theatre configuration is 2000 seats.
OPS-PLEN-VWO：For the Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre, the fire safety and egress verification log confirms that an emergency egress plan is active throughout the interior corridors and emergency exit network, while the venue architectural specification register records a plenary seating capacity of 4000 seats in the grand plenary auditorium configured for theatre use.
OPS-PLEN-DD4：For the Olympus Grand Forum Complex, an active emergency egress plan is in place for the interior corridor and emergency exit network, and the grand plenary auditorium provides a plenary seating capacity of 3200 seats in theatre configuration.
